installSteps: Copy cyclorama-dawn.conf, cyclorama-steel.conf, and cyclorama-day.conf into ~/.config/kitty/themes/.
Reload Kitty config (Ctrl+Shift+F5) or switch interactively with `kitten themes`.
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: Matte #050507 dark stage with Beacon Orange focus and Steel Blue secondary accents.
themes.copySnippet:

## blurb: Matte #050507 dark stage with Beacon Orange focus and Steel Blue secondary accents. (LX 263 Dark · Cyclorama Dawn v2.3.2)

# Basic colors
foreground              #F4F5F8
background              #050507

# Cursor & URLs
